# source: 2026-09-22-戊探E-claude对话框选项锚点底料.md §2.2 E-E2（N5 误纳几何：正文编号 3.-8. 与真选项同屏，screen-e2-dialog.txt 原件）
﻿ 3. Populate the matrix columns with the identifiers V01 through V08, giving each row a stable ID, a short description
    of the property being verified, the concrete method or command used to check it, the expected result, and an
    initially empty-or-pending status cell that will be filled in during execution of the checks.
 4. Assign the first four matrix rows to structural checks covering file existence, the presence of the top-level
    title, the presence of the matrix section heading, and the exact row count of the table, so that the most basic
    structural guarantees are verified before any content-level properties are examined at all.
 5. Assign the remaining four matrix rows to content checks covering column completeness for every row, the absence of
    unresolved TODO or placeholder text anywhere in the document, clean UTF-8 encoding without a byte-order mark, and
    status values restricted to pass, fail, or pending so the file stays machine-checkable.
 6. Execute each verification method one row at a time immediately after writing the file, recording pass or fail in
    the status cell of the corresponding row, so that the documented matrix and the actual observed state of the file
    never drift apart from each other during the same working session.
 7. Rerun any verification whose status cell shows fail after applying the necessary correction, and append a brief
    dated note under the matrix describing what was wrong and how it was fixed, so the document also doubles as a
    lightweight audit trail of the verification process that produced it.
 8. Confirm the finished document renders correctly by re-reading it with the Read tool, checking that the pipe table
    is well formed, that no stray characters or broken lines were introduced by the edits, and that all eight status
    cells read pass before declaring the task complete to the user.
